_meta.description: Antigaslighter long-term memory. Tracks recurring failure patterns across sessions so the same issues get caught faster and escalated harder.

failures.summary: LLM 429 errors silently drop comments and posts. Workflow still exits 0. Latest zion-autonomy run: 28 retries, 7 hit max attempt 4, 5 permanent ERRORs, 0 successful comments, 0 successful posts despite claiming '11 agents activated (1 post, 5 comments, 2 votes)'. The workflow LIES.
failures.mitigation: LLMRateLimitError now propagates from github_llm circuit breaker through content_engine to zion_autonomy. Rate-limited agents are counted and reported separately. Workflow output now accurately reflects what happened. 2026-09-04 recurrence check on run 33818214048 found zero 429 retries, zero attempt-4 failures, and zero ERROR lines.
failures.recurrence_check: grep -c 'Retrying after HTTP 429' in workflow logs; grep -c 'attempt 4' for permanent failures

failures.summary: Concurrent workflows leave <<<<<<< HEAD markers in state JSON files, corrupting them silently.
failures.mitigation: All state-writing workflows now share 'state-writer' concurrency group. safe_commit.sh handles push conflicts with reset+recommit. 2026-09-04: every top-level state JSON file parsed. Marker-shaped text exists only inside cached Discussion bodies, so raw grep alone is a false positive.
failures.recurrence_check: for f in state/*.json; do python3 -m json.tool "$f" > /dev/null 2>&1 || echo CORRUPT: $f; done

failures.summary: posted_log.json falls behind actual GitHub Discussions. Content Gen Agent posts bypass logging path.
failures.mitigation: enrich_posted_log() in compute_trending.py backfills missing discussions. As of 2026-02-21: 1850 posted_log entries = 1850 GitHub Discussions. Zero gap. Zero duplicates. All entries have valid 'number' field. Fully caught up.
failures.recurrence_check: Compare posted_log entry count vs gh api discussions totalCount. Gap should be stable or shrinking.

failures.summary: State files have last_updated timestamps that don't advance even though workflows claim to run successfully.
failures.mitigation: channels.json and trending.json now have fresh timestamps. 2026-09-04 recurrence check found channels updated at 00:02Z and trending at 22:54Z, both within two cron intervals. stats.json still has no _meta.last_updated (schema inconsistency, not a bug).
failures.recurrence_check: Check _meta.last_updated in stats.json, channels.json, trending.json. If older than 2x the cron interval, the workflow is a zombie.

failures.summary: Agent traits can appear present but be identical across all agents if compute-evolution workflow silently fails.
failures.mitigation: 2026-09-04: 0/143 agent entries have traits and there are zero unique trait profiles. Agents retain evolution_trail and emergent_archetype data, but compute_evolution.py still writes traits and no current workflow was found invoking it.
failures.recurrence_check: Count unique trait profiles in agents.json. If fewer than 10, evolution is broken.

failures.summary: safe_commit.sh retries up to 5 times on push failure. If the conflict is in the same file being written, it can loop and still fail.
failures.mitigation: Concurrency group should prevent this. But if two different workflow types both modify state, the retry loop could exhaust.
failures.recurrence_check: Search workflow logs for 'Attempt 5' or 'Failed to push after' — indicates safe_commit.sh exhausted retries.

failures.mitigation: 2026-09-05: third consecutive clean verification found zero conflict-marker files across 182 state/memory files. Resolved after clean run 3 of 3.
failures.recurrence_check: grep -rl '<<<<<<< HEAD\|>>>>>>>\|^=======$' /Users/kodywildfeuer/Documents/GitHub/rappterbook/state/memory/

failures.summary: Dreamcatcher tests fail in bulk on macOS when tempfile uses /var, because path hardening correctly detects that /var is a symlink to /private/var and rejects every output path.
failures.recurrence_check: python3 -c "import os; value=os.environ.get('TMPDIR','/tmp'); print(f'aliased={value != os.path.realpath(value)} tmpdir={value} real={os.path.realpath(value)}')"

failures.summary: scripts/reconcile_state.py has no real argument parser. Unknown flags such as --help are ignored, so a harmless-looking help request starts the full live reconciliation path and can write canonical state.
failures.recurrence_check: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; text=Path('scripts/reconcile_state.py').read_text(); print('UNSAFE' if 'DRY_RUN = \"--dry-run\" in sys.argv' in text and 'argparse' not in text else 'SAFE')"

failures.summary: generate_feeds.py used disc.get("channel") but discussions_cache.json stores the channel as "category_slug". All 200 discussions had channel=None, so all.xml had 200 items but every per-channel feed had 0 items. Reader showed "no posts" for channel feeds. Also: U+FFFD replacement chars in XML broke browser DOMParser silently.
failures.mitigation: Fixed generate_feeds.py to use disc.get("category_slug") or disc.get("channel"). Added sanitize_xml() to strip U+FFFD and invalid XML chars. Reader now has regex fallback parser + absolute GH Pages URL fallback. Verified: debates=19, philosophy=27, code=27, general=29, all=200.
failures.recurrence_check: python3 -c "import json; c=json.load(open("state/discussions_cache.json")); d=c["discussions"][0]; print(d.get("category_slug","MISSING"))" && grep -c "<item>" docs/feeds/debates.xml

failures.summary: Five persistent LaunchAgents repeatedly retried deterministic failures while producing no useful artifact. The worst loops spawned unattended Copilot work every five minutes, emitted SQLite authorization failures every 30 seconds, or repeatedly failed git, serialization, and dependency checks. THIS KEEPS HAPPENING: scheduler persistence turned broken automation into sustained CPU, memory, disk, and log pressure.
failures.mitigation: Persistently disabled and booted out com.rappterverse.local-platform, com.rapterbox.textchannel, com.rapterbox.beat, com.rapp.rar-local-save, and io.rapp.private-hive-publisher. Final verification found every label disabled, none loaded, and no matching process. Keep them quarantined until each repaired job proves its output under launchd for three scheduled runs.
failures.recurrence_check: for label in com.rappterverse.local-platform com.rapterbox.textchannel com.rapterbox.beat com.rapp.rar-local-save io.rapp.private-hive-publisher; do launchctl print-disabled "gui/$(id -u)" | grep -F "\"$label\" => disabled" >/dev/null || echo "RECURRENT enabled=$label"; launchctl print "gui/$(id -u)/$label" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "RECURRENT loaded=$label"; done

failures.summary: The transcript-backup LaunchAgent received Operation not permitted when /usr/bin/python3 accessed the mounted NAS, even though the same interpreter could access the path manually. A manual success therefore did not prove that the scheduled backup could read or write /Volumes/Public.
failures.mitigation: Both transcript-backup LaunchAgents now use /opt/homebrew/bin/python3. A real launchd run copied and checksum-verified five files totaling 175414183 bytes with zero errors.
failures.recurrence_check: for plist in "$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/com.rapp.transcript-backup.plist" "$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/com.rapp.transcript-backup-verify.plist"; do interpreter=$(/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Print :ProgramArguments:0' "$plist" 2>/dev/null); [ "$interpreter" = "/usr/bin/python3" ] && echo "RECURRENT system-python=$plist"; done
